A realistic page made of the widgets of the other demos: an address book of 2,500 contacts, searched by facets.
  • A SplitPanel holds the filters on the left and the contacts on the right. Drag its divider to share the space differently, or collapse the filters with the arrows on it
  • Each category of the filters, the country, the year of birth and the profession, is a CollapsiblePanel: click its title to fold it. Its header holds an action, an eraser on the right that clears the filters of the category; it shows only while there is something to clear. The actions of a CollapsiblePanel are new: addAction adds them, outside the summary, so a click on one neither folds nor unfolds the panel
  • On top of each category, a MultiAutocomplete finds any of its values as you type, with how many contacts have it, and shows those chosen as chips; the x of a chip deselects it. Below, the most common values are check boxes. Both choose the same filters, and either deselects them
  • The counts are those of faceted search: a category counts the contacts the other categories leave, so choosing Spain leaves the counts of the other countries as they were, while the years and the professions count the contacts in Spain only
  • Above the table, the filters chosen are chips too, each with an x, and "Clear all" on the left clears every category
  • The table is a JsonBasedDynamicDataTable, its rows rendered in the browser from JSON: rows to select, sortable columns, pages of 25, 50 or 100 rows, a search by name or email in its navigation, columns to resize, to move by their handle and to hide or show with the column chooser (City is hidden at first), and an export of the selected contacts, or of all, as CSV
  • The card in each row shows the contact in a Modal; the arrow saves the contact as a vCard, the file address books import
